text: たいへんねー　これ　あげるから　つかって！

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb gives the reason for what comes next. あげるから = 'I'll give it to you, so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own at the end is a casual request, like てください without the ください. つかって = 'use it'.
